# EventCard

One row of the events list: a gold serif date block on the left, the event's name, venue, start time and ticket chips beside it.

`FOB.EventCard` · Cards

## Use

```jsx
<FOB.EventCard date="…" name="…" location={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="FOB.EventCard" date="…" name="…" location="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |

| `date` * | `string` | "YYYY-MM-DD" |
| `name` * | `string` |  |
| `location` * | `{ name: string }` |  |
| `time` | `{ start: string }` |  |
| `ticket` | `{ presale?: { price: string }; regular: { price: string }; type? }` |  |
| `type` | `'Publico' \| 'Privado'` |  |
| `passed` | `boolean` | Override the date-before-today check. |
